comment: Per-tier exact-match targets and CI floors for the LaTeX extraction benchmark. `target` is the goal: 99.9% is claimed for pdfLaTeX with Computer Modern and AMS fonts only, so tiers set in other fonts (and scanned pages) have no target until their baselines are understood. `floor` is the gate: a run below it fails. Floors sit one point under the measured baseline (see BENCHMARK.md) because glyph positions are measured against the browser's fallback fonts, which differ between machines; they only move up. `heldout` lists the tiers of the held-out set (corpus-heldout/), which has targets but no floors: it is measured at phase gates, not gated in CI. Edited by hand; the corpus builder never touches this file.
